units.source_text: 过了几天，小姐的神态渐渐变得坦然了。

en.t: After a few days, the young lady gradually began to seem more at ease.

units.source_text: 即使我和K都在家的时候，她也常常走到K房间的檐廊上，

en.t: Even when both K and I were at home, she would often come to the veranda outside K's room,

units.source_text: 叫声他的名字，然后走进去，坐上好久。

en.t: call his name, then go inside and sit there for quite a long time.

units.source_text: 当然无非是送信件或洗好的衣服之类的事。

en.t: Of course, it was only for things like bringing letters or clean laundry.

units.source_text: 在一个屋檐下住着，这些往来虽说也没什么可非议的，

en.t: Since we lived under the same roof, there was really nothing to criticize in such comings and goings,

units.source_text: 但是，对于一心想独占小姐的我来说，却总是觉得无法释然。

en.t: but for me, who wanted her all to myself, I could never feel at peace about it.

units.source_text: 有时，我甚至觉得小姐似乎在故意回避我，不到我房里来，只去K的房间。

en.t: At times, I even felt that she was deliberately avoiding me, not coming to my room and going only to K's.

units.source_text: 你可能会问，那你为什么不让K搬出去呢？

en.t: You may ask, then, why I did not make K move out.

units.source_text: 如果这样做，我硬把K拉来一起住的初衷就被否定了，

en.t: If I had done that, it would have denied the very purpose for which I had forced K to come live with me,
so I could not do it.
